an4.46:1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:--Imaṃ
an4.46:1.2: bhikkhave rattiṃ Rohitasso devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yen' āhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave Rohitasso devaputto maṃ etad avoca
an4.46:1.3: :--Yattha nu kho na jāyati . . . na uppajjati, sakkā nu kho so bhante gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vāti?
an4.46:1.4: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave Rohitassaṃ devaputtaṃ etad avoca
an4.46:1.5: :--Yattha kho āvuso na jāyati . . . na uppajjati nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmīti.
an4.46:1.6: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Rohitasso devaputto maṃ etad avoca
an4.46:1.8: yāva subhāsitaṃ c' idaṃ bhante Bhagavatā--yattha
an4.46:1.9: kho āvuso na jāyati . . . na uppajati nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena . . . pattayyan ti vadāmi.
an4.46:2.1: Bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante Rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo.
an4.46:2.2: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpo javo ahosi seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katupāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchātiṃ atipāteyya,
an4.46:2.3: evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi seyyathāpi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo.
an4.46:2.4: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpena javena samannāgatassa evarūpena ca padavītihārena evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji--ahaṃ
an4.46:2.6: So kho 'haṃ bhante aññatr' eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatr' eva uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamatha-paṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā va lokassa antaṃ antarā yeva kālakato.
an4.46:3.2: yāva subhāsitaṃ c' idaṃ bhante Bhagavatā-
an4.46:3.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati . . . na uppajjati nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyan ti vadāmīti.
an4.46:3.4: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave Rohitassaṃ devaputtaṃ etad avoca
an4.46:4.1: :--Yattha kho āvuso na jāyati . . . na uppajjati nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayam pattayyan ti vadāmīti,
an4.46:4.2: na cāham āvuso appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhass' antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an4.46:4.3: Api cāhaṃ āvuso imasmiṃ byāmamatte kalebare saññimhi samanake lokañ ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ ca lokanirodhañ ca lokanirodhagāminiñ ca paṭipadanti. 2.
an4.46:6.4: nāsiṃsati lokam imaṃ parañ cāti. 47. 1. Cattār'
